material.acceptance_criteria: The browser job records load-to-ready milliseconds and the median frame time from the page, and fails when either exceeds a ceiling stored in .github/perf/browser-baseline.txt.
material.description: rust/crates/web/site/main.js records ticks, unit count and the centre pixel but no load-to-ready time and no frame duration. .github/perf/tick-baseline.txt covers only the server tick. The CI browser job asserts that the map is present and never times it.
material.resolution: The browser records load and frame p99 (data-load-ms, data-frame-p99-ms) and CI prints browser load ms frame_p99_ms against a stored ceiling. The ceiling comes from one measured load with a margin, a stated caveat.
material.subject: The browser client has no measured frame time or load time
material.witness_plan: The page writes data-load-ms and data-frame-p50-ms to body; the CI job reads them, compares against the stored ceilings with the same self-check pattern as tick-latency-regression, and fails on a value above its ceiling.

note: The browser records load and frame p99 (data-load-ms, data-frame-p99-ms) and CI prints browser load ms frame_p99_ms against a stored ceiling. The ceiling comes from one measured load with a margin, a stated caveat.
